# hiok_id_member (Resource)

Someone invited to work in this account with a role. They get an email and accept it after signing in; status shows invited, active or disabled.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String)

### Optional

- `role` (String) owner, contributor or reader.

### Read-Only

- `effective_role` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) invited, active or disabled.
